items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 01 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic as various weak fronts and troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the east overnight, becoming variable 2 to 4 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start with a risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches. Rain or showers developing later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain, showers or mist, very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northeast 2 to 4, veering east or northeast later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain becoming isolated later. Ongoing risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain or mist, very poor in fog patches.
